location: Jackson Town Hall Council Chambers 150 E. Pearl Ave.
title: The purpose of this meeting is to receive information regarding air transportation in Wyoming. The Committee will consider updates on air service from Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, SkyWest Airlines, the Wyoming Department of Transportation, and the Wyoming Airports Coalition. The meeting will not be streamed on YouTube but participants may attend by Zoom. An audio recording of the proceedings will be available after the meeting.
